notes: The two smaller sizes (NP_02 s2.1-s2.2) as data. Since PAC-065 the interrupt block is honoured (NP_04 s4): 'his special' (SCR-09) is his hissatsu cast broken in its window or a Loud string the pattern tags INTERRUPT, and SCR-17's Loud rung accepts either; both are offered only against an opponent with a breakable special. A SCRAP is one micro-objective from data/scrap_objectives.v1.json over a hard 30s cap with no Tension meter: objective met = win, a constraint broken = loss, the cap = judged on EP. A SPAR is one 90s segment with full EP and DROPs, the personal meter capped at 50 (hissatsu practicable, transforms locked) and lab flags. Opponents are boss patterns; a stand-in pattern by style carries an NPC card's strings when the card is not a boss (the greybox has no assembler). Ep1's bouts run by name. Since PAC-068 a card may carry `stablemate: true` (NP_08 s5.1: a spar with a stablemate bonds the pair +3 a time to the +15/day soft cap) - the Priya trial's card does. Since PAC-070 a card may carry `generic: true` with a `tier` (1-3) and an optional `seed`: the opponent fights on strings assembled for the card by the generic opponent assembler (NP_04 s9) - its Style, its House's tell dialect (else its own name's, on the gym's tells), the tier's loudness and pieces - instead of the stand-in boss's; `opponent` still names the boss whose slot, club and index the bout borrows. Ep1's four cards are generics (the CHALLENGER, MARCUS and JUNE at tier 1, PRIYA at tier 2).

lab_flags.mirror: fight a copy of your own fighter - the adaptation tracker turned into content: his record assembled into a pattern (PAC-093, the rules below)

mirror.text: NP_02 s2.2's mirror spar. The adaptation tracker (C7) keeps a record of each fighter across every dual, scrap and spar: the punches by row, the feints, every two- and three-token sequence thrown, the sequences it read, the counter windows his defense opened and the punch he threw into them. The copy is a pattern: his sequences thrown min_count times or more as its strings (ranked by thrown x length, one inside a string already taken skipped, up to the tier's count - 2 at tier 1, 3 above), their shares as its SELECT, the Style's pieces filling what the record cannot. Its tracker opens reading his read_seed most-read sequences at the tier the reads reach (capped at read_tier_max) - C7's read, defense only. When its read makes him miss it counters as he does: his most-thrown counter punch at his rate (counters / windows), once he has counter_min counters. A mirror books no Pattern Intel: the pattern is his own.
